purpose: Separate text-free Prism HUD resources for transfer to the main project.

provenance.method: New deterministic vector reconstruction; not recovered original SVG art.

iconArtwork.policy: Reuse existing skill, class and role icons; this package only supplies empty artwork Images, frames and masks.

import.slice: Do not resize pointed or octagonal art with arbitrary nine-slicing.

boss.fillMode: clip the fixed full-width fill to the full inner polygon and the moving pointed end
boss.atFull: use complete inner polygon including both pointed tips

cast.fillMode: clip the fixed full-width fill to the full inner polygon and the moving pointed end
cast.atFull: use complete inner polygon including both pointed tips

player.fillMode: clip the fixed full-width fill to the full inner polygon and the moving pointed end
player.atFull: use complete inner polygon including both pointed tips

party.fillMode: clip the fixed full-width fill to the full inner polygon and the moving pointed end
party.atFull: use complete inner polygon including both pointed tips

gauge: full-width fill clipped by live ratio
slot: existing game icon clipped by inner mask
